preset.description:
A ready-made permission set to use instead of `policy_ids` (send exactly one of the two):

- `mail-send` (Send email): Send email from your verified domains and check what happened to it. Cannot read message bodies or change domains.
- `waitlist-write` (Waitlist sign-ups): Add and update sign-ups on your waitlists, and read the waitlists. Cannot export, delete or invite.
- `trawl-jobs` (Extraction jobs): Start, cancel and read web-extraction jobs and their results.
- `flags` (Manage flags): Create, edit, toggle and delete feature flags and segments in every environment, including protected ones, and manage projects and environments. Cannot reveal or rotate SDK keys, change webhooks or read confidential values.
- `flags-dev` (Edit flags outside protected environments): Create and edit feature flags and segments, and change their values in environments that are not protected. Cannot touch protected environments, delete or see SDK keys.
- `notify-send` (Send notifications): Send notifications, create and update recipients, mint recipient tokens for your apps and read the message log. Cannot change push credentials, notification types, settings or webhooks.
- `notify-readonly` (Notify read-only): Read recipients, notification types, channels, settings, webhooks and the message log. Changes nothing and sends nothing.
- `readonly` (Read-only): Read-only across the workspace: settings, members, email, waitlists, communities, web-extraction jobs, feature flags and notifications. Changes nothing.
- `full` (Full access): Every action this workspace exposes, except creating keys, editing roles and policies, and other actions that hand out access. Use a custom policy for those.

The first key minted with a preset creates a managed policy for it in this workspace (named "<label> preset", `preset_key` set); later keys reuse that policy, so editing it changes every key bound to it. When the definition of a preset grows (a new product, for example), existing preset policies are updated to match, unless an owner has edited their statements. `readonly` and `full` are the same permission sets as the MCP connection presets of the same name. No preset can create keys, edit roles or policies, or hand out other access.

info.description:
PlatformUser authentication and workspace administration for ProductCraft. Owns sign-in, sign-up, password reset, workspaces, members, invites, workspace roles, workspace-service toggles, and the introspect endpoint every other backend uses to resolve permissions.

## Rate limits

Every route is limited per client IP over a sliding 60-second window: 10 requests for sign-in, sign-up, token refresh, sign-out, password reset, invite acceptance and OAuth client registration; 60 for the OAuth token endpoint; 600 for the MCP delegated authorization decision; 60 for everything else. Over the limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds. Sign-in also limits attempts per identifier (`TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`).
